$comment: Machine-readable transcription of BRIEF.md 6.2 (scale) and 6.3 (gates) as modified by Jonathan's rulings of Nov 19, 2026. Owned by Jonathan (CODEOWNERS); frozen once approved. 'text' quotes the brief or the ruling; 'metric' names the harness result key a condition reads; 'ruling' cites the ruling that changed the brief.
source: BRIEF.md 6.2 and 6.3, as of Nov 19, 2026, with rulings 1, 2, 4, 5 and 7

scale.$comment: 6.2. Defaults until Jonathan replaces them with first production adopter numbers.

M1.scenario: Leaf write with no interceptor in scope

conditions.text: ≤ 2.0× a raw native write in the same framework (Node, 1×)
zero allocations per write over 1M writes (C1)

reported.text: absolute timings are reported, never gated
absolute timings are reported, never gated

M2.scenario: Leaf read through a held handle

reported.text: absolute timings are reported, never gated
absolute timings are reported, never gated

M3.scenario: Build a tree from 100,000 leaves of initial state and access 10 of them

conditions.text: ≤ 2× the heap of the plain state plus 10 native cells (C6)

reported.text: ≤ 1 ms in the brief; absolute timings are reported, never gated

S1.scenario: Form edit: one keystroke in the 500-field form

S2.scenario: Live grid: 50k × 20 collection, 1,000 rows rendered, 500 updates/s for 60 s

conditions.text: Zero long tasks attributed to the store (long animation frames attributed by overlap with the signal-tree: marks)
store heap overhead ≤ 1× the retained size of the plain row objects

S3.scenario: Bulk replace of 50k rows with { chunk: 'auto' }

S4a.scenario: Agent batch: agent apply, inspect(), rollback, no holds

S4c.scenario: Agent batch applied while the user types into a held field every 100 ms

S5.scenario: Soak: 8 hours of S2 + S4 traffic with the plugins that exist at the phase installed; the final S5 has transactions, restoration({ retain: 100 }) and writers

plugins.text: whichever plugins exist at that phase; the final S5 has all three

nightlyCompression.text: nightly may compress time but must apply at least 2M writes

conditions.text: Heap growth over the final half of the run ≤ 2%
every plugin's internal collections stay at or below their configured caps

S6a.text: a core-only bundle contains no plugin code (symbol scan)

S6b.text: with every plugin attached to a different 10% subtree, M1, S1 and S2 stay within ±5% of a bare tree

S6c.text: the core-only bundle has identical bytes with and without the plugin folders

S7.scenario: Contention: a write to a location held by 1, 2, 8 and 32 owners, where owners = pending transactions plus declared holders on the location

conditions.text: cost(n) ≤ cost(1) + n × 0.5 µs at Node 1× (provisional coefficient), for n = 1, 2, 8, 32 owners
an uncontended write is unchanged (±10%) with 10 vs 10,000 links elsewhere (C4)

Q1.owner: tests and the oracle, not this harness

conditions.text: the oracle finds zero unlisted differences
every adapter passes its conformance and bypass suites
